steps.title: Heat the milk
steps.body: Heat **3 cups whole milk** and **1 cup half and half**.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Stir together in a separate bowl: **¼ Dutch cocoa**, **½ cup sugar** and **¼ tsp cinnamon**.

steps.title: Make the paste
steps.body: Add a small amount of the warmed milk mixture to the dry ingredients to form a paste, then mix in with milk and simmer to avoid clumps, but do not boil.
